The visible patch excerpt is a documentation table edit: Gemma 4 gets wider prefill chunk/step defaults (2048/4096), a new bidirectionalMediaPrefillChunkCeiling row, and an adjusted solo-prefill-stripe description. The excerpt is marked incomplete, so the other head ranges (1143-1201, 2205-2224) were not seen.

The visible patch has no security-control change. It does not alter authentication, attestation, encryption, cache scoping, or the T-041 SSD cache posture (HMAC names, 30-minute TTL, scoping by coordinator-authored cache salt). Coordinator-to-provider trust boundaries are untouched.

The base text I reviewed describes the Nemotron Super slot, memory admission, prefix bank cache scoping (per authenticated tenant scope, cold without a scope), and GLM5Next boundaries. It was read as context only and no changes to it are visible. The Gemma 4 wider prefill chunk claims are documentation; the real code (EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift) was not supplied. If code changed in the same PR, it may affect memory admission (T-010, T-029 availability). That is an unverified integration question, not a finding.

Residual uncertainty: head ranges 1143-1201 and 2205-2224 were not visible, so any documentation of security-relevant behavior there (for example cache or media handling) is unreviewed.
